findings.summary: Closed source/core/control/real proof chain as an accepted read-only GPIO bank source-status frontier.
Recorded paired no-MMIO/no-RP1/no-GIC control proof as satisfied before the real diagnostic proof.
Retained rejected first real run, known-good control, and decisive rerun as capture hygiene evidence while accepting only the decisive identity-joined rerun.
Updated roadmap and project contract docs for the accepted frontier.

GPIO event generation, pending generation beyond the read-only snapshot, delivery, IAR/EOIR acknowledgement, handler ownership, GPIO ownership, pin-control, clock/reset, DMA/cache, storage, generated-root, networking, SSH, broader PCIe, Milestone 11.3, and phase transition remain future work.
Raw 0xdeaddead INTE/INTS values are treated only as visible read-only diagnostic snapshot data, not as proof of event generation, delivery, GPIO ownership, or handler ownership.

nextAction: Set planningNeeded=true for supervisor planning of the next Milestone 11.2 feature slice; do not create a same-shaped GPIO bank source-status rerun task.
